items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I think the number was Christine the number on there was Christine Evan Hall had copied that number off that record

ctx.x: was he playing alto or tenor or a band?

no he had I come to think about it I believe he between Edmund Hall and Edmund Washington they had a C melody sax in there some kind of way I believe that first song that Edmund Hall had was a C melody that's what it was but he had a fast year he could hear a tune and then once and then play it down because he couldn't he could spell it but he couldn't read but after he would learn the melody then Edmund Washington would take and play the second part you see a lot of times Edmund Hall they would switch because he…
